description: Compute a SHA-256 HMAC using the caller-supplied `participantAuthSecret`. Server environment secrets are never used. Use a test secret during implementation; keep production signing in your backend. `affiliateJoin` requires permission for this signed-in user to join the affiliate program directly.
name: growsurf_participant_auth_hash

outputSchema.description: The participant authentication hash for the given email.

hash.description: The computed hash. Pass it to the GrowSurf client as the participant's `hash` value.

title: Compute Participant Auth Hash
